responsibility: Implements the detailed scheduler description for the z10 processor family, modeling its dual S/T pipelines, branch grouping, forwarding/receiving classes encoded through z10prop attributes, address-generation bypass timing, and dispatch-delay interactions between integer, floating-point, and decimal/vector-style functional units. GCC uses this file to schedule z10-targeted RTL with more precise superscalar and forwarding behavior than earlier s390 CPU models.
